notes: Main issue: the SCIENCE block had æ/ø/å stripped to plain ASCII across nearly every loc_title, loc_instruction, family loc_name/loc_skill_full, and several sciBinLabels — but these are display strings, not slugs, so they MUST carry correct Bokmål characters. Restored: hører/grønnsaker/kjæledyr/sommerklær/vinterklær/kjøretøy/på/ønsker/høne/rekkefølge/livssyklusen/livssykluser/å sette/fjær/kjøttetere. The LITERACY block was already clean (correctly used æ/ø/å) and natural — no literacy text fixes needed; terminology (førstelyd/sistelyd/midtlyd/vokaler/konsonanter/stavelser/språklig bevissthet) is correct K-register Bokmål and slugs are correctly ae/oe/aa-folded. SLUG fix: science-sequence slug 'rekkefolge-…' kept a bare 'o' where the source ø should fold to 'oe' → 'rekkefoelge-og-livssykluser' (consistent with the foerstelyd/bildeordforraad/spraaklig folding convention already used). All other slugs valid. 'Trekk en strek' (science) vs 'Tegn en strek' (literacy) — both are natural Norwegian; left the existing inconsistency since each is correct in isolation, though a future harmonization to 'Trekk en strek' would read slightly more like a typical NO worksheet. Note 'Krypdyr' for Reptiles is the standard NO term — correct. 'Para sammen i naturfag' / 'Sortere i naturfag' family names are natural.
